title: AgentFeedback submission envelope
description: One submission as the server stores it after inference. Custom x- keywords: x-max-bytes (UTF-8 byte limit), x-trim (surrounding whitespace removed before validation, storage and hashing), x-normalize: "token" (trim, lower-case, runs of whitespace to "-"), x-recommended (a missing member warns), x-unique-by (duplicate values of the named member warn), x-on-violation ("warn", the default; "truncate": an over-long string is cut to the limit, with a warning in the envelope and silently inside a kind schema; "move": the member is moved into payload with a warning, envelope only). The schema describes what the server produces; it is never used to reject a submission.

kind.description: What the payload is. Schemas attach to (kind, schema_version). Server-shipped: friction, review. Missing or empty: stored as unknown.

schema_version.description: Version of the payload schema for this kind. Absent: 1, silently. Present but not spelled as a plain positive integer at most 2^53-1 (1.0, 1e0, "2", 0): 1 with a warning.

key.description: Producer idempotency key, unique within kind. Optional.

summary.description: One human-scannable line. Newlines are replaced by spaces.

model.description: Model id of the reporting agent.

project.description: Repository or project name as the producer knows it.

occurred_at.description: When it happened, producer clock, any RFC 3339 offset. Stored as UTC microseconds. Unparseable: dropped into context.occurred_at_raw with a warning.

context.description: Flat string map of auto-collected metadata. Non-string values are encoded as canonical JSON into strings with a warning. Never part of content identity.

git_dirty.description: true or false as the collector saw it

app.description: non-code: the application the agent serves

workspace.description: non-code: team space, tenant or environment name

url.description: non-code: page, ticket or document the agent was working on

channel.description: non-code: slack, email, web, voice, api

task_id.description: non-code: the unit of work in the agent's own system

occurred_at_raw.description: server-added: the occurred_at text that did not parse

rekinded_from.description: uid of the submission this one re-kinds

origin.description: how the submission came to be: agent, hook-nudge, session-scan, inbox, import; another value is stored as sent

detector.description: name and version of the tool that pointed the agent at the friction

session_harness.description: harness of the session the submission is about, when that is not the submitting harness

payload.description: Kind-specific content. Absent: built from the top-level members the envelope does not know. Validated as a guide against schemas/kinds/<kind>.v<schema_version>.json when the server has it.
